title: Fundamentals of Programming II
description: Change the description to: “Definition, properties, representations and real-world applications of abstract data types. Including: design, tracing, implementation and analysis of common algorithms, software libraries, pointers, storage allocation and program traces. Introducing object-oriented programming concepts, abstraction, encapsulation, inheritance, polymorphism, generic programming, command-line interfaces, Big-O analysis, recursion and systematic test case design and analysis.
